changelog: Fixed (critical): bandwidth limits now actually throttle a device to the chosen speed instead of cutting off its internet entirely — a leftover traffic-marking rule could clash with other security/firewall software and block all traffic
Fixed (critical): the app could fail to initialize on some installs because a required component was not packaged into the build — all components are now bundled and verified before shipping
Fixed: per-device bandwidth limits no longer collide — each device gets its own traffic-control class (previously two devices could clobber each other's limit)
Fixed: kernel network settings (reverse-path filter, forwarding tunables, transmit queue length) are now saved on start and fully restored when the app stops, instead of leaking
Improved: updating is more reliable — the app verifies the new version installed before finishing, and relaunches cleanly instead of leaving a duplicate process running
Fixed: paid features now stay locked until your account plan is confirmed
Added: a 'Later' option after an update so you can keep working and restart when ready
Fixed: leftover backup files are now cleaned from the install folder after each update
Fixed: the app logo now shows correctly across all screens (dashboard, AI setup, AutoPilot)
Added: a back button on the AI setup page to return to the dashboard
Fixed: the network monitor no longer freezes the interface when stopping
Fixed: AutoPilot no longer shows an upgrade popup on free-plan startup
Fixed: memory leak in the connection tracker during long sessions
Fixed: firewall (iptables) forwarding rules are now cleaned up properly on stop
Fixed: a rare crash when closing the app during startup or plan loading
Security: hardened the installer against malicious update archives (path-traversal protection)
